contribution.concept: Dual-path neural network model for cross-modal retrieval

evidence.evidence: A dual-path neural network model is proposed for couple feature learning in cross-modal information retrieval.

method.concept: Graph Convolutional Network for text modeling

evidence.evidence: One path utilizes Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) for text modeling based on graph representations.

method.concept: Neural network with nonlinearities for image modeling

evidence.evidence: The other path uses a neural network with layers of nonlinearities for image modeling based on off-the-shelf features.

problem.concept: Mapping different modalities into a common semantic space

evidence.evidence: The main challenge is to map different modalities into a common semantic space, in which distance between concepts in different modalities can be well modeled.
